title: It`s Atlas again
author: Bani Mohanty
text:
Dusk descends with chilling whisper,
Twilight brings the curtain down,
Restless ego fizzles and fizzles,
The gloom settles at downtown.

Poor caterpillar.
Waited and waited, so patiently waited..
For a metamorphosis, it can never see
Who has seen it  ? Who has seen it ?  It`s so ethereal even to feel it !

The dawn is humming, humming from the wings,
Give me a chance, give me a chance..

Palm full of bright, blinding rays flush  in
The wait is over  ! the wait is over !!

Here comes Atlas with  apples in hand,
Hercules smiles.. wipes sweat from head,
Thank you, dear. Thank you, dear. I could see you  at the tunnel end.

À wry smile, oh that wicked.. smile !
Gloom descends, descends  again .
Spreads , into the black holes, spreads again ,

Why I ? Why I   ?
Free  bird  me, will fly away from pain !

Give me a break, give me a break !
Hercules  lowers it with clever grace,
Zooms merrily  away with no guilt trace..

And It`s  Atlas  again, it`s Atlas  again..

Yes.Alas...Its Atlas again…!
